description: Map the prospect's current reporting workflow and agree the two or three use cases the purchase has to cover
Order form with seat count and annual price; standard 30-day payment terms
Countersigned through e-signature; deal marked closed-won in the CRM
Walk through the six-week rollout plan and agree who the customer's admin is and when the data export is due
Load 24 months of exports from the customer's old system; rejected rows get chased with the customer
Create the tenant, connect SSO, set up roles and switch on the modules that were purchased
Customer admin signs in for the first time and invites their team
Review which dashboards people actually open and what is blocking the rest
Usually a permissions or report-export question within the first two weeks
Compare usage against the original use cases ahead of renewal and discuss expansion
